title: TypeSomething chat window (v2)
description: A big white browser-style window (a paper title bar with three dots, the first in lime) holding a chat thread: ink bubbles from the assistant on the right and baby-pink bubbles from the customer on the left, each beside a round avatar with a white ring. Messages fade in and rise 12px one by one as they scroll into view.
notes: avatars are media slots: pass an img or leave them empty for placeholder circles
joined drops the top padding so it sits right under the section before it (as on the page)
the reveal is a CSS view timeline; without it, or with reduced motion, every message just shows
